instrumental of vidhāna, referring to the prescribed method
instrumental plural of a compound listing ritual substances used for inscription

items.question: What procedure and substances are required for inscribing the prepared diagram?
premises: The preceding verses specify the materials and form of the inscribed diagram.
This verse prescribes following that same procedure.
The inscription is to be made using rocanā, aguru, and kuṅkuma.
items.inference: The diagram described earlier is to be inscribed by this very procedure with rocanā, aguru, and kuṅkuma.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the procedure depends on the fuller ritual sequence in the surrounding verses.
items.plain_english: By this very procedure, it should be inscribed with rocanā, aguru, and saffron.
